headline: ARC-2 cutoff rise pushes guoqin gu out of gold

sections.text: guoqin gu slipped from 16th to 17th without a score change, falling just outside ARC-2’s 16 gold places.
The cutoff rose 0.84 in the past day to 65.56; guoqin gu sits at 64.72, 0.84 short.
